title: prefill-decode: enable chunked prefill + speculative prefill + stage overlap for lower tail latency and higher throughput
author: Ariel Thompson
description: Background: Our current prefill->decode pipeline serializes the work: a full prefill (kv-cache build) completes before any decode tokens are produced. For long context lengths this increases tail latency and underutilizes GPU resources during decode. This PR implements three complementary optimizations: chunked prefill, speculative prefill, and stage overlap. Goals: reduce 95/99th latency for long-prefill requests, increase sustained throughput through better packing of work on GPUs, and keep behavior compatible with existing model semantics and KV cache correctness. Approach: 1) Chunked prefill: split long prefill sequences into configurable chunks (default 512 tokens) and process them sequentially into the KV cache. Each chunk commit is made durable in the runtime but does not require waiting for subsequent chunks before starting decode. 2) Speculative prefill: when client prompts include an explicit decode request (e.g., streamable generation) and the first chunk completes, we begin speculative decode on the current KV snapshot while later prefill chunks are still in flight. Speculative decode runs against a read-only snapshot of the KV cache and includes corrective logic to roll back or finish when later chunks arrive if speculative prefixes are invalidated. Speculation is gated behind a feature flag and only enabled for models where speculative consistency is well-defined. 3) Stage overlap: change the runtime scheduler to allow overlapping GPU kernels and queueing between prefill and decode stages. We introduced lightweight per-request stage state, a contention-aware scheduler that schedules chunked prefill and decode kernels in the same GPU stream when safe, and cross-stage batching to merge small decode work with concurrently available prefill chunks. Kernel & scheduling changes: - Added a new kernel handshake to avoid re-binding model kernels between adjacent stage executions when tensor shapes and device placement are compatible. - Introduced an adaptive batching window for cross-stage batching that grows/shrinks based on observed inter-arrival times. - Extended KV cache data structures with versioned snapshots to allow safe speculative reads without impacting concurrent prefill writes. Correctness & safety: - Speculation is opt-in via runtime flag and off by default. - When a speculative decode path detects a conflict (e.g., later prefill chunk changes KV keys used by generated tokens), we emit corrective telemetry and either patch the output (when safe) or abort speculative frames and restart decode against the fully committed KV cache. - Added invariants and assertions in debug builds to catch KV snapshot misuse. Benchmarks: - Synthetic perf lab (gpt-like medium model, 2048 token prefill): 95th latency reduced from 620ms to 480ms (-22.6%), 99th from 920ms to 710ms (-22.8%). - Throughput: end-to-end throughput for mixed prefill/decode workload increased by ~25% in sustained runs due to improved packing and reduced idle GPU cycles. - Tail-case improvement larger for models with long prefills (>1024 tokens) where chunking and overlap shine. Rollout & feature gating: - Feature is behind feature flag runtime.enable_prefill_overlap (off by default). - Canary rollout: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% after 2 days of canary metrics and no regressions. - Telemetry added: per-request speculative_attempts, speculative_conflicts, stage_overlap_time_ms, cross_stage_batch_size. Testing: - Unit tests for KV snapshot/versioning and speculative conflict detection. - Integration tests covering chunk boundaries, partial chunks, and prefill-only vs prefill+decode flows. - Performance harness tests in perf-canary repo; bench scripts used to collect numbers included in PR. - CI flake fix: addressed a nondeterministic KV snapshot race found during initial CI runs (added an RT semaphore and test harness). Migration notes: - No API surface changes. - Behavior is backward compatible when feature flag disabled. - Documented in release notes and runtime flags in the runtime configuration docs.

Feature gated behind runtime.enable_prefill_overlap. Rollout via canary. Observability: new telemetry for speculative attempts and conflicts.
